dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Reliability - Golden Metrics and Apdex
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for backend Apdex, throughput, latency, error rate, saturation, and target rationale. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Golden metrics
pages.description: Service quality signals for the backend PHP APM entity.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(cpuPercent), average(memoryUsedPercent) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.activeProcesses), latest(php_fpm.pool.listenQueue), latest(php_fpm.pool.maxChildrenReached) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute), percentile(duration, 95), percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Initial Apdex target is 0.5 seconds. Keep it until seven stable production days show a stronger baseline.
